summary: LORÉ v4 (audio messaging + TTS + voice + call + dialogue/action). Backend: 78/78 pass (51 regression + 27 new). Frontend: all v4 spec testids present and working — mic↔send swap, audio file picker, TTS hover button, dialogue/action italic separation, typing-indicator mood reflects character (shy/1.6s for Elara), CallScreen modal opens with gradient + push-to-talk, VoiceSection has all 6 voice radio cards with previews + sample upload + ElevenLabs ID.

ui_bugs.issue: Close button has aria-label='Close call' but no data-testid='call-close'. Minor — caused 30s hover timeout in test because modal intercepts pointer events. Add data-testid='call-close' for reliable test automation.

action_items: (LOW) Add data-testid='call-close' to CallScreen close (X) button.
Server.py is now ~1090 lines — consider splitting into modules (auth/files/characters/chat/personas/messages/tts) when next iteration adds features.
critical_code_review_comments: dialogue_only() correctly strips *actions* and [IMAGE: ...] tags; returns '' when only actions present (verified via util tests + 400 path on /messages/{mid}/tts).
/api/upload accepts audio/* via either ALLOWED_AUDIO set OR ct.startswith('audio/'); 12MB cap enforced for audio (vs 5MB for image); 13MB rejected (verified).
send_message correctly transcribes audio_path via Whisper, appends transcript to user_content, and feeds it into the system prompt with quoted transcript context. Returns 400 for unknown audio_path.
/api/messages/{mid}/tts uses character.voice_id (default 'alloy') for synthesis; returns 404 for cross-user message access (security verified).
All 6 OpenAI voices (alloy/echo/fable/nova/onyx/shimmer) generate >1KB mp3 in ~2s each via /api/tts/preview.

Frontend Chat.jsx: composer correctly hides send and shows mic when (!input && !attached?.path && !isRecording); typing-indicator inline-styles animationDuration based on detectTypingMood result (verified 1.6s = 'shy' for haunted/wry/guarded character description).
VoiceSection: previewVoice() ignores Audio.play() promise rejection — fine in modern browsers but could log to console on autoplay block.
useVoiceRecorder REC_MIN_SEC=15 is enforced both in hook stop() guard and in Chat.jsx auto-stage useEffect (defense-in-depth).

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all spec testids verified; only call-close testid missing — non-blocking)
